candidate_workaround: Assert the required candidate and preferred values by key, verify the fixed state vocabulary separately, and retain zero-valued states rather than comparing the full map to a partial literal.
failure_signature: A current-phase test compares a complete fixed-vocabulary state summary to a partial mapping and fails because valid zero-valued keys remain present.
recurrence_guard: For fixed complete vocabularies, assert required keyed values and the vocabulary separately; never treat a partial expected map as the full serialized state.
rollback: Give the failed aggregate zero terminal credit, leave the route held, and revert only the additive test assertion if its focused witness fails.
scope_boundary: Owner-local test-contract correction only; no scientific, production, authority, independent-reproduction, or Stage 20 credit.
title: Assert complete Method Flow state vocabularies without partial-map equality
trigger_preconditions: A deterministic summary includes valid zero-valued state keys and a test expects only nonzero keys.
